topic: Which enchanted discovery would you explore?

files.name: 01.png
files.label: THE HARBOR LANTERN
files.must_show: An ornate brass lantern with glowing amber glass is large in the foreground beside a harbor.
files.observed_subject: A large pierced brass lantern with a glowing candle and amber panels sits prominently on a harbor stone ledge at sunset.

files.name: 02.png
files.label: THE STARGAZER TELESCOPE
files.must_show: A large brass telescope on a tall decorated pedestal dominates a nighttime observatory.
files.observed_subject: An enormous decorated brass telescope on an ornate pedestal fills an open stone observatory beneath the starry night sky.

files.name: 03.png
files.label: THE CELESTIAL SPHERE
files.must_show: An ornate armillary sphere with a dark celestial globe and golden orbital rings dominates a terrace table.
files.observed_subject: A gold ringed armillary sphere enclosing a dark blue celestial globe stands prominently on a desk overlooking a sunset city.

files.name: 04.png
files.label: THE SECRET GARDEN DOOR
files.must_show: A large ornate turquoise-and-gold double door with floral metalwork stands in an ivy-covered stone entrance.
files.observed_subject: Tall teal and gold double doors covered with flower and vine patterns dominate an ivy-covered stone garden archway.

files.name: 05.png
files.label: THE BLOSSOM BRIDGE
files.must_show: A large arched stone bridge spans the foreground of a turquoise river beneath cherry blossoms.
files.observed_subject: A broad stone arch footbridge with lantern posts spans turquoise water under pink flowering trees in a mountainous landscape.
